verdict.rationale: Circle documents an official MCP server that an LLM or AI-assisted IDE can integrate, and a probe confirms the dedicated MCP docs page exists. Its stated purpose is code generation and fixing for Circle's offerings (Wallets, Contracts, CCTP, Gateway), not live operational actions. Missing for 10: connection/setup details, a documented tool list, MCP-driven operational actions (e.g. transfers), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Integrate Circle's MCP server to let your LLM or AI-assisted IDE generate and fix code for crypto apps using Circle's offerings, including Wallets, Contracts, CCTP, and Gateway.
official MCP server documented at https://developers.circle.com/ai/mcp
